title: Pharmacy Settings
subtitle: Manage legal information and contact details for your pharmacy

labels.show_pharmacist: Show pharmacist's name on receipt and invoice
labels.show_order_sale_margin: Show selling price (incl. VAT) and margin in orders
labels.expiry_cutoff_last_day: Expired on the last day of the month
labels.expiry_cutoff_first_day: Expired from the 1st day of the month

placeholders.receipt_header: Text that will appear at the top of the receipt...

hints.label_printer: Use Detect, then select the dedicated printer in TSPL label mode (Hoin HL80B/HLB480B). This setting is local to this workstation; browser printing is used if unavailable.
hints.auto_print_ticket: In centralized checkout, starts printing when the preview opens. Silent with QZ Tray; otherwise the usual print dialog opens.
hints.pharmacy_name: The official name as it will appear on invoices and receipts.
hints.pharmacy_name_from_licence: The pharmacy name is defined by the activation licence. To change it, contact your system administrator.
hints.niu: Mandatory tax identifier for tax filing.
hints.logo: The logo will appear on cash receipts and invoices. PNG or JPG, max 2 MB.
hints.receipt_header: Use \n to go to a new line.
hints.ticket_footer: Displayed at the very bottom of the receipt.
hints.show_pharmacist: The name comes from your licence. Some owners prefer not to display it — it only appears if the option is enabled.
hints.low_stock: Number of days of autonomy remaining before considering stock as low.
hints.dormant_stock: Number of days without sales to consider a product as dormant.
hints.debt: Total amount of customer debt above which an alert is displayed.
hints.auto_logout: Inactivity duration before automatic logout (0 to disable).
hints.taux_change: EUR to FCFA conversion rate. Automatically applied to new direct orders.
hints.show_order_sale_margin: Shows the "Selling price incl. VAT" and "Margin" boxes in the summary bar, both when entering an order and in the order details. Uncheck to hide them.
hints.expiry_cutoff: For a lot expiring in MM/YY: "last day" keeps it sellable for the whole month; "1st day" treats it as expired from the 1st of the month. Applies to sales, alerts and reports.
hints.whatsapp_help: Requires a Meta Developer account and WhatsApp Business API configured.
hints.pharmacist_whatsapp: The number that will receive strategic and inventory reports (do not include a + prefix).
hints.payment_modes: Disable payment modes you do not use. They will no longer be offered at the register and invoicing.
hints.custom_mode: Type a name and press Enter or click Add. Do not forget to save.
hints.multi_pos: If enabled, the system allows dispatching sales to different physical terminals.
hints.centralized_cash_register: Groups sales by daily session for centralized closing.
hints.require_validator_password: When disabled, the seller no longer has to enter a password to send a sale to the register. Specific validations (discount, price override, return, negative stock) are still required.
hints.sudo_session_minutes: After a successful validation, the same validator can validate for this duration without re-entering their password. 0 = disabled (password on every action).
hints.qz_tray: Requires QZ Tray installed and running on this workstation. The thermal printer will be used in native ESC/POS mode when available.
hints.telegram: Create a bot via @BotFather, copy the token, send /start to the bot, then retrieve the Chat ID.
hints.telegram_start: Send /start to your bot before clicking Retrieve.
hints.monthly_report: Configure the items to include in the monthly report
hints.monthly_report_enabled: Sent every month to configured recipients
hints.report_items: Check the items to include in the monthly report
hints.hide_cash_totals: If enabled: cashiers will not see the live summary (totals by payment mode) or amounts in the cash closing report. The owner (admin) will always see everything. Uncheck to allow cashiers to track their cash register in real time.
hints.billetage_obligatoire: Forces the cashier to count notes, coins and mobile money via an assistant at cash closing. Uncheck to allow free amount entry.
hints.fiscal_intro: Configuration of the tax regime applicable to the pharmacy.
hints.regime_fiscal: Real: 2% deposit + 1% prepayment. Simplified: 5% deposit + 3-5% prepayment.
hints.mode_imposition: Administered margin: specific to drug distributors.
